results.title: Brian Jagde Withdraws from Arena di Verona & Puccini Festival Due to Health Issues
results.description: (Credit: Chris Singer) Brian Jagde has canceled his upcoming performances at the Arena di Verona and Puccini Festival due to health issues. The tenor took to social media and said, ” I hope you’re all having a good summer and spending time with friends & family. I was looking forward to enjoying some time off myself in between performances this month, {...} The post Brian Jagde Withdraws from Arena di Verona & Puccini Festival Due to Health Issues appeared first on OperaWire .
